Tribune Sabina Ostorius.description: commander of the Bruma Legion garrison, Cassius's legate and patron -- recommended him for the Dragonguard, Colovian, blunt, exacting

Count Skorm Ice-Vein.description: Count of Bruma, Nord noble house sworn to the Empire for four hundred years, proud, wary of Legion overreach after this year's blame-letters with the pass garrison

Captain Voreno.description: commander of the Bruma Pass garrison, sharp-tempered, impatient with civil process, convinced the Count's merchants are hoarding grain during the closure
